title: SEC0: parse_sse_frame drops all but last data: line
description:
The SSE spec (html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html) allows multiple 'data:' lines in a single frame, which should be concatenated with newlines. Current implementation at watch.rs:69-70 only stores the LAST data line, discarding all previous ones.

Effect: SSE frames with multi-line data payloads will be corrupted. Example:
  data: {"msg":
  data: "hello"}
Will only extract '"hello"}' instead of the full JSON.

Fix: Accumulate data lines into a Vec<String> and join them with newlines before returning, similar to how event_type and id are handled.
